SELECT m.*
        FROM materials m
        INNER JOIN (
          SELECT path, MAX(version) AS max_version
          FROM materials
          WHERE kind = 'spec'
          GROUP BY path
        ) t ON m.path = t.path AND m.version = t.max_version
        WHERE m.kind = 'spec'
        ORDER BY m.path
